text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Successful introduction of leasing firm Maroc-Leasing on the Stock Exchange which has been oversubscribed 21.5 times for the initial 212,660 shares.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali on official visit to Italy.
- National Council for Youth and the Future to set up regional employment agencies.
- Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini says his country studying Morocco's requests for preferential rates on loans.
- Polisario Front reiterates call for negotiations with Morocco over referendum in Western Sahara.
- European statistics show that about 1.2 million Moroccans live in the European Union.

- Authorities preoccupied by the way to boost investments. Economic think-tank Centre Marocain de Conjoncture said recently that efforts to promote investment would be useless if not accompanied by less red tape.
